articles.title: Mick Jagger, 83 años, entrena de cinco a seis días a la semana y corre 12 kilómetros al día: "Me acuesto a las dos de la madrugada y me levanto a las diez de la mañana"
articles.standfirst: El líder de The Rolling Stones revela los hábitos de ejercicio, dieta y descanso que le mantienen en plena forma
articles.summary: El líder de The Rolling Stones revela los hábitos de ejercicio, dieta y descanso que le mantienen en plena forma
articles.body: Mick Jagger sigue desafiando al paso del tiempo. A sus 83 años, el líder de The Rolling Stones mantiene una rutina de entrenamiento propia de un deportista de élite: se ejercita entre cinco y seis días por semana y cuida al detalle su alimentación y su descanso. Esa disciplina es la que le permite seguir dándolo todo sobre el escenario, donde puede llegar a recorrer hasta 19 kilómetros en un solo concierto. Lejos quedan los excesos de sus primeros años en el rock. El cantante británico ha apostado por un estilo de vida enfocado en la longevidad y en el bienestar físico y mental, una transformación que explica buena parte de su sorprendente vitalidad. Jagger trabaja bajo la supervisión de un entrenador especializado en atletas de alto rendimiento. Su programa combina disciplinas muy distintas con un objetivo claro: ganar fondo, fuerza y flexibilidad. Alterna sesiones de musculación con carrera, sprints, ciclismo, natación e incluso kickboxing. A esa base se suman clases de danza y de ballet clásico, fundamentales para conservar la postura, el equilibrio y la agilidad que exhibe en cada actuación. Completa su rutina con yoga y pilates, dos prácticas que le ayudan a mejorar la movilidad de las articulaciones y a reducir el estrés. La alimentación es otro de los pilares de su forma física. Su dieta se basa en productos ecológicos y en hidratos de carbono complejos de calidad, como el arroz integral, el pan artesanal y las legumbres, que le aportan energía de forma sostenida. El músico dejó atrás las drogas y, a los 58 años, redujo de forma drástica el consumo de alcohol, consciente de que debía cuidar su cuerpo a largo plazo. El descanso tampoco se negocia. Jagger sigue un horario de sueño estricto: se acuesta en torno a las dos de la madrugada y se levanta a las diez, lo que le garantiza unas ocho horas de sueño para recuperar los músculos y llegar con la mente despejada a sus compromisos. Su caso demuestra que constancia, buena alimentación y descanso son claves para envejecer con salud.

articles.title: Cine Odeon reabre nesta quinta; reinauguração tem ingressos esgotados | G1
articles.standfirst: A reabertura faz parte da primeira fase do programa Reviver Cinema, da Prefeitura do Rio, com a Secretaria Municipal de Cultura e a RioFilme, voltado à revitalização dos cinemas de rua da cidade.
articles.summary: A reabertura faz parte da primeira fase do programa Reviver Cinema, da Prefeitura do Rio, com a Secretaria Municipal de Cultura e a RioFilme.
articles.body:
O Cine Odeon, na Cinelândia, Centro do Rio, um dos mais tradicionais da cidade, reabre nesta quinta-feira (29) após seis anos sem programação regular. A reabertura será com a exibição do filme “Feito Pipa”, candidato a representar o Brasil no Oscar 2027 . Os ingressos para as duas sessões desta quinta, entretanto, estão esgotados.

A reabertura faz parte da primeira fase do programa Reviver Cinema, da Prefeitura do Rio, com a Secretaria Municipal de Cultura e a RioFilme, voltado à revitalização dos cinemas de rua da cidade. O Odeon pertence ao grupo Severiano Ribeiro/Kinoplex e completa cem anos em 2026.

Quem perdeu a oportunidade, entretanto, terá outras chances. Até 4 de novembro, os ingressos para filmes do Odeon custam R$ 12. A partir do dia 5, o valor será de R$ 15 para qualquer público e sessão. A programação ainda será divulgada.

Inaugurado em 1926, o Cine Odeon, na Cinelândia, é um dos símbolos da época em que grandes salas de exibição transformaram o Centro do Rio em um polo cinematográfico. Construído no terreno do antigo Convento da Ajuda, o cinema integrava o chamado “quarteirão dos palácios de cinema”, cuja concentração de salas deu nome à região. Após períodos de fechamento e reformas, tornou-se uma das principais casas do Festival do Rio, desde a primeira edição do evento, em 1999. Em 2015, passou a se chamar Cine Odeon — Centro Cultural Luiz Severiano Ribeiro.

articles.title: Boney Kapoor was paid for the hair transplant reveal Janhvi Kapoor, Arjun Kapoor on 'Koffee With Karan', Varun Dhawan says his hair looks amazing
articles.summary: Boney Kapoor’s hair transformation became a talking point in 2024 after the film producer underwent a hair transplant.
articles.body: Boney Kapoor’s hair transformation became a talking point in 2024 after the film producer underwent a hair transplant. Now, his children, Janhvi Kapoor and Arjun Kapoor, have shared an interesting revelation about the procedure, claiming that their father was paid to get it done.The disclosure came during the latest episode of ‘Koffee With Karan’, when host Karan Johar asked Janhvi to share an entertaining rumour about her father that she would like to spread as part of the rapid-fire round.Janhvi was quick to respond, joking, “That he didn’t get a hair transplant done. And he grew his hair by concentrating.” Her brother Arjun burst out laughing before adding, “But if you roam around, you wouldn’t believe it.”Janhvi then asked Arjun, “Have you seen dad’s banners?” To this, he replied, “That’s called marketing.”Karan Johar soon brought up Boney’s makeover, saying, “I forgot to talk about Boney Ji’s makeover.” This prompted Janhvi to reveal, “Can I tell you that he has been paid to get a hair transplant?” A surprised Karan asked, “What, he got paid?” Both Janhvi and Arjun confirmed that it was true.Clarifying what she meant, Janhvi added, “He has not paid to get a hair transplant. He has gotten paid.” Varun Dhawan, who was also present during the conversation, praised the producer, saying, “But his hair looks amazing.”Karan, still taken aback by the revelation, asked, “So he is paid, that’s why he is smashed all over the city?” The siblings once again confirmed his assumption.Janhvi also revealed that more promotional banners featuring her father were in the pipeline. “There are more coming. I have got an approval of five more banners of him looking in the mirror without hair, sad, and with hair, happy,” she said, leaving the others laughing.Boney first drew attention to his hair transformation in 2024, when he travelled to Hyderabad for the inauguration of a hair transplant clinic. A video of the producer discussing his procedure subsequently surfaced online, in which he spoke about Eugenix and its role in his hair transplant.He later opened up about his decision to undergo the procedure, along with his weight-loss journey. Speaking at a press conference organised by the clinic, Boney recalled how his late wife, Sridevi, had encouraged him to lose weight before addressing his hair loss.

articles.title: 'Lioness' star Jill Wagner raises daughters in Tennessee town of 800, where horses and buggies still roam
articles.summary: "A Very Arctic Christmas" and "Lioness" star Jill Wagner traded Hollywood for a Tennessee town of 800, where Mennonites ride horses and buggies.
articles.body: From the high-stakes action of "Lioness" to the holiday adventure of "A Very Arctic Christmas," Jill Wagner is taking on two very different worlds. But off camera, the actress has traded Hollywood's hustle for a quieter life raising her two daughters on a Tennessee farm in a town of just 800 people — where horses and buggies are still a familiar sight. "First of all, I love Tennessee … I'm from the South. I'm from North Carolina," she told Fox News Digital. "I love the people here but especially love the small-town mentality." 'RANSOM CANYON' STAR JOSH DUHAMEL SAYS HE'D RATHER PUT MONEY INTO NORTH DAKOTA AFTER SELLING LOS ANGELES HOME Life in her Tennessee town offers a glimpse of a world that can feel far removed from Hollywood. "I was at the post office this morning and one of the Mennonites was in front of me … I got to look at their horse and buggy," she said. Wagner said the small-town atmosphere has become an important part of the childhood she and her husband want to give their girls. The actress explained why she hopes her daughters will eventually appreciate the slower pace, even if they someday follow in her footsteps and move to bigger cities. WATCH: JILL WAGNER TRADES HOLLYWOOD HUSTLE FOR TENNESSEE FAMILY LIFE "In some ways, going back to a simpler, slower pace … I think as we get older, or at least I know I can speak for myself, as I get older, I really value that," she added. Wagner knows the pull of Hollywood firsthand. She left home at 17 to pursue a career in entertainment and suspects her daughters may one day be eager to spread their own wings. But she hopes they'll always remember what their upbringing gave them. ‘SOPRANOS’ STAR JAMIE-LYNN SIGLER FLED HOLLYWOOD FOR TEXAS WHERE SHE NO LONGER FEELS ‘WATCHED’ "And I'm sure they'll do the same, but I hope what it does is bring them back to the simple-ness of life and what it can be … That's a gift that my husband and I gave them, and they probably don't even know it yet," she said. Away from the action of "Lioness," Wagner is embracing the holiday spirit in "A Very Arctic Christmas," reuniting with Cameron Mathison for a festive adventure. Wagner plays Jane, a wildlife conservationist who helps a father and daughter navigate an unexpected Arctic adventure after their holiday cruise goes off course. The actress said working with Mathison brings plenty of laughs to "A Very Arctic Christmas" set. "There's never any dull moment when you have Cameron Mathison and I on set together. In fact, it's hard for us to get through a scene without laughing, I'm sure. Robin Dunne, the director, is always rolling his eyes, like, ‘Oh, guys, guys, guys, guys, bring it in,'" she laughed. WATCH: JILL WAGNER DISHES ON THE ON-SET CHAOS WITH CO-STAR CAMERON MATHISON For Wagner, the holiday films also have a personal connection. The actress has found ways to include her daughters in her Christmas-movie tradition. When Wagner's daughters were younger, she included them in one of her films as extras, giving them a chance to sit on Santa's lap. Now that they're older, Wagner said they understand that Christmas movies are a genre of their own — and she hopes the experience becomes a lasting family tradition. "And I just hope that one day when I'm long and gone, that is a tradition with each other's families is that they get on Christmas, and they get to watch that movie and just kind of laugh at the fact that we're all in a movie together at Christmas," she added. While Wagner's career continues to take her between intense action roles and feel-good holiday projects, she values sharing those experiences with her daughters while giving them a childhood rooted in small-town life. When Fox News Digital asked whether her daughters were becoming the Tennessee farm girls she had envisioned, Wagner admitted there's still some work to do. "So, I don't know about farm girl. I know that … they love outdoors. They don't necessarily like doing farm work. So, we're trying to still work on that," she laughed. "They do love running around barefooted in the dirt, and they can play outside all day long, which I love for them," Wagner said. The family hopes to add chickens and goats when Wagner's work schedule allows more time at home. "Maybe one day we'll get a horse or a pony for them," she added. GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE But for Wagner, the biggest perk of small-town life isn't just the farm — it's the neighbors who show up when it matters. Her family owns Scott Mansion Farms, where they host charitable events benefiting the Special Operations Warrior Foundation and Dolly Parton's Children's Hospital. Wagner said the community's support has been especially meaningful. LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS "But the fact that people just show up at the gate and say, ‘What can we do to help?’ I think it just reminds me of how amazing humanity is … and how very special it is to have good neighbors," she said. Wagner also hopes her daughters inherit her love of local festivals and community traditions. PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE "It's woven into my fabric. So, I'm going to pass that on to my girls. Hopefully they'll have the love for that like I do," she said. "A Very Arctic Christmas" premieres Oct. 29 on Great American Pure Flix. articles.title: Priyanka Chopra says Nick Jonas made sure to set up his tour to be home for 'Karwa Chauth', drops adorable PICS with Malti Marie: 'No one like my guy'
articles.summary: Priyanka Chopra and Nick Jonas continue to set relationship goals with their thoughtful gestures.
articles.body: Priyanka Chopra and Nick Jonas continue to set relationship goals with their thoughtful gestures. The actress recently revealed that her husband adjusted his ongoing tour schedule to ensure he could be home with her for Karwa Chauth, making the occasion even more special for her.Expressing her appreciation for Nick, Priyanka shared a heartfelt note on Instagram, praising him for understanding the significance of the festival and making arrangements without her having to ask. She wrote, "He came home without me asking him to.. knowing how much it would mean to mm and I.. he made sure tour was set up to be home for karwachauth.. (Teary eyes emoji) No one like my guy… May a love like this find you all.. happy karwachauth (Red heart emoji)"The actress also offered a glimpse into the celebrations, sharing pictures and moments featuring Nick and their daughter, Malti Marie Chopra Jonas.Nick is currently on tour with his brothers Joe and Kevin Jonas as part of the Jonas Brothers' 'Burning Up Tour All Over Again'. Inspired by their 2008 'Burning Up Tour', the North American concert tour kicked off in New York on August 20, 2026, and is scheduled to continue until December, with performances planned across the United States and Canada.Earlier in the day, Priyanka gave fans a peek into her Karwa Chauth preparations, showing off her intricate mehendi design dedicated to her husband. Sharing a picture of her palm adorned with henna, the 'Barfi' actress wrote, “Piya ke naam ki.. happy karwachauth to all those celebrating.”She followed it up with another picture of her mehendi, referring to the traditional practice of applying sugar syrup to intensify the colour of henna. “The question is, will the chashni work? IYKYK,” she captioned the post.Priyanka and Nick tied the knot in December 2018, celebrating their union through both Christian and Hindu wedding ceremonies. articles.title: Susanna Griso estalla tras conocer cómo se desencadenó el siniestro ferroviario de Urda: "¡De locos!"
articles.standfirst: La televisiva comentó que no entiende cómo Atocha no sabía que hubiera un tren parado durante 15’ en las vías antes de la colisión
articles.summary: La televisiva comentó que no entiende cómo Atocha no sabía que hubiera un tren parado durante 15’ en las vías antes de la colisión
articles.body: Este miércoles, 28 de octubre, en Urda (Toledo) un tren de alta velocidad (AVE) de Renfe impactó con uno de Iryo que estaba detenido. El accidente deja 69 muertos y varias decenas de fallecidos. Tras el suceso, Óscar Puente, ministro de Transportes, compareció para comunicar la información que tenía al respecto. Puente indicó que seis trenes se detuvieron en la ruta de Madrid-Andalucía tras fallar el sistema de seguridad LZB. A partir de ahí, la gestión pasó al centro de control de Atocha, que se encargó de indicar los próximos pasos a seguir. Sobre las 8:31 horas, el maquinista del AVE comunicó que se había “caído” la central de Urda, en referencia al sistema LZB. Desde Madrid le comentaron que desconectarse y volviera a conectar el LZB y reanudase la marcha al amparo del BSL de manera “normal”. Por otro lado, a las 8;41 horas, el Iryo contactó con Atocha, comentando que estaban parados en la entrada de Urda, varios kilómetros delante del AVE. La respuesta desde Atocha fue la siguiente: “Desconecte y vuelva a conectar el sistema LZB para reanudar la marcha al amparo del BSL con marcha normal”. A las 8:48 horas tuvo lugar la última conversación y la maquinista de Iryo insistió en que no podía revisar el sistema LZB y que seguía detenida. El controlador de Adif le comentó que volviera a llamar si tenía algún problema. Tan solo seis minutos después, a las 8:54 horas, tuvo lugar el fatal desenlace. En este contexto, las opiniones siguen llegando. Una de las más recientes fue la de Susanna Griso, presentadora de ‘Espejo Público’, que estalló tras la explicación después de esta recreación del accidente. La comunicadora de Atresmedia se manifestó de la siguiente manera al respecto: “Yo soy la persona más tranquila del mundo. No tengo ninguna psicosis, he seguido viajando en tren, pero no me genera ninguna seguridad esto que estamos contando”. “Que haya un tren durante 15’ parado en una vía y Atocha no lo sepa y le diga al otro tren, en este caso, al AVE, que siga a velocidad normal...es de locos!”, sentenció visiblemente indignada.

articles.title: Halle Berry loses custody to ex Olivier Martinez amid abuse allegations
articles.summary: Halle Berry will remain without primary custody of the 13-year-old son she shares with ex Olivier Martinez, who accused the actress of physical abuse.
articles.body:
Halle Berry will remain without primary custody of her 13-year-old son.

A decision has been made in the ongoing legal battle between the actress, 60, and her ex Olivier Martinez after he accused her of physically abusing their son Maceo. On Thursday, Oct, 29, Los Angeles Superior Court judge Shelley Kaufman dismissed Martinez's request for a domestic violence restraining order, but denied Berry's requests for 50/50 custody and overnight visits, according court documents obtained by NBCLA .

The former couple, who split in 2015 after two years of marriage, previously shared joint custody until Martinez, 60, was granted a temporary restraining order earlier this month. At the time, the French actor cited an incident on Sept. 26, during which Berry allegedly "attacked" Maceo by "jumping on him, putting her hands around his neck, and choking him," per documents obtained by USA TODAY.

Halle Berry's life in the spotlight – Photos of her highlights

Martinez further alleged several prior instances of abuse involving the teen and sought sole legal and physical custody. While Kaufman ultimately rejected a permanent domestic violence restraining order, she ruled that the custody arrangement from the TRO would stay in place pending additional proceedings.

This leaves Berry, who denies all allegations, with joint legal custody, but limited physical custody of Maceo.

In a statement to USA TODAY after the Oct. 29 ruling, Berry's attorney, Marina Beck, said, "We are extremely pleased that the Court has dissolved the TRO. As we move forward, Halle is determined to continue to focus on the well-being and best interests of her family."

Martinez's lawyer, Patrick Baghdaserians, told TMZ that his client having primary physical custody is a "huge victory."

USA TODAY has reached out to lawyers for Berry and Martinez for comment.

Berry's attorney Beck previously addressed Martinez's allegations in an Oct. 1 statement to USA TODAY. Calling Martinez's filing "entirely meritless and deliberately misleading," Beck said there is extensive evidence, including previous court rulings, that Berry's ex repeatedly violated court orders, interfered with their son's therapeutic and educational care and alleged he has been legally sanctioned for his conduct."In a way, today's filing is not entirely unexpected from an individual with a well-documented history of erratic, possessive and violent behavior," Beck said. "Fortunately, Halle is used to this kind of outrageous conduct from Mr. Martinez and, while she is deeply saddened, she will not allow it to deter her from fighting for Maceo's best interests and providing him with the love and support he needs."

Berry and Martinez married in July 2013 and welcomed Maceo later that same year. They filed for divorce in 2015 and it was finalized in 2023 after an eight-year legal battle, with both agreeing to joint legal and physical custody of their son Maceo and for Martinez to receive $8,000 a month in child support.

Halle Berry's daughter spoke out in support of her mom

The "Catwoman" star also shares 18-year-old daughter Nahla Aubry with ex-boyfriend Gabriel Aubry. Nahla Aubry submitted a written declaration on Oct. 3 in support of her mom, in which she told the court she was "shocked, very sad, and very upset" by Martinez's claims.

"Having lived with my mom my entire life and having personally observed her relationship with Maceo for years, the allegations are completely inconsistent with the mom I know," Aubry wrote, calling Berry "a loving and devoted parent" who has "has always encouraged" both her and her brother "to maintain loving relationships with our fathers."

Aubry accused Martinez of being on "quest to destroy my mom" and said she is "heartbroken" to see Maceo "become the subject of a public dispute that he may not fully understand."

"Based on my observations throughout Maceo's life, I believe he loves our mom very much and shares a close bond with her. I have seen him hug her, kiss her, tell her he loves her, seek her comfort, and enjoy spending time with her," Aubry's declaration read. "At the same time, I have also witnessed occasions when Maceo has been disrespectful, at times aggressive, and unwilling to follow rules at home."

She added, "When that occurred, my mom responded the same way she did with me when I was growing up: by enforcing appropriate boundaries and consequences, such as limiting screen time, imposing time-outs, or restricting access to electronics and play dates. I never observed anything abusive about her parenting."
